briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief - Mon 2026-11-09 (SGT)

  • NAV: S$10,227,030, reported +0.45%; real day move approx +0.09% (S$+9,315 vs Friday's 10,217,715). Friday's real move was -0.29% as Asia absorbed the US crash.
  • Biggest mover in book: SMIC -4.04% Friday (HK$45.58) on US-crash spillover - but held well above the week's HK$41.06 low.
  • The one thing: blockbuster NFP (+165k vs +65k exp, U-rate 4.1%) all but locked a December Fed hike, yet the 10y closed 4.859% - still 34bp below the 5.20% duration gate - and VIX fell back to 25.64. Weekend Iran diplomacy (Trump: war "highly unlikely"; Vance given "a few days") kept oil's war premium deflating, but Hormuz tanker incidents continued.

State and flags

  • riskFlags: ZERO - second consecutive clean snapshot.
  • L46.SI (Lum Chang): Yahoo 404, 28th consecutive session.
  • listedChgPct +2.68% is a pre-US-rebound snapshot quirk; Friday Asia actually fell (STI -2.21%, HSI -1.27%).
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2826 (touch softer SGD), USDCNY approx 6.665.

Position moves (Fri 6 Nov)

  • Asia: STI 5,179.17 (-2.21%, now -7.65% in a month); HSI 24,481.86 (-1.27%, but +5.10% on the week). Xiaomi HK$30.38 (-2.94%); SMIC HK$45.58 (-4.04%); Tencent close not retrieved.
  • US Friday rebound: SPX +0.31% to 7,376.86, Nasdaq +1.09%, Dow -0.46%; NVDA +2.78%. Still SPX's worst week since June; NVDA earnings 17 Nov is next test. BTC approx $75.7k after $1.25bn liquidations.
  • NFP: +165k vs +65k exp; Aug/Sep revised +84k; wages +0.4% m/m. December hike effectively locked. 10y 4.859% (+2.2bp); VIX 25.64 (-9%).
  • OCBC Q3 BEAT: +3% y/y to S$2.04bn; NII six-quarter high S$2.31bn; record WM AUM S$358bn; NPL 0.8%; 9M record S$6.24bn (+10%). Banks week: DBS missed, OCBC beat, UOB done 4 Nov.

Insider trades (7d)

  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): Cheng Wai Keung Form 1 cadence PAUSED - no new filings since 4 Nov (2/3/4 Nov items covered Friday).
  • No other held SGX names; no HKEX items for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi. US ETFs - none by construction.

US Congress filings (filed 4-8 Nov)

  • Notable: a House Republican BOUGHT NVDA twice on 23 Oct ($1k-15k each), disclosed 5 Nov - took Thursday's -9% hit within a fortnight.
  • House Democrat (NJ-5): bought AMAT (26 Oct) and BHE, sold TLK - filed 6 Nov.
  • House Republican: sold CSCO, bought NVDA x2 and PG x2 (23 Oct trades) - filed 5 Nov.
  • House Republican (PA-16): sold Fairfax VA GO bond $50k-100k, bought NC Housing bond $50k-100k - filed 5 Nov. House Republican (OH-5): bought FMAO - filed 4 Nov (in Friday's brief).
  • Unusual Whales politics feed

Trump / policy watch

  • NFP blockbuster locks December hike; Hassett: labor demand "skyrocketing".
  • Iran diplomacy's best weekend: Trump to CNN - renewed war "highly unlikely" on a "very strong agreement"; Vance has "a few days"; Iran's Doha proposal demands sanctions relief, frozen assets, reparations; Araghchi offers Hormuz reopening within two days.
  • But kinetic tape continued: Qeshm/Bandar Abbas explosions, tanker mine strikes (UKMTO), US disabled M/V Huda in Gulf of Oman, third carrier group arrived. Oil can gap either way tonight.
  • Week ahead: US CPI (the key gate input), China inflation, UK GDP, BoJ SOO, NZ elections.
  • Singapore rates: OCBC says higher SORA net-positive for NII; US-rate rises pressure now, help as assets reprice.

Risk

  • IBKR silver line: at approx $51.9 silver, collateral approx S$118,285 vs S$56,240 loan - collateral/equity approx 1.91x (1.93x Fri). Improving but cushion still nearly halved vs mid-Oct.
  • Hot-NFP regime risk: Friday's "NFP not hot" trigger did NOT fire - duration deployment waits for Wednesday's US CPI.
  • Iran two-tail risk: deal gap-down or Hormuz gap-up both live for oil and silver.
  • FX: ~35% of net worth non-SGD. Concentration: SGX banks mixed week into CPI tape. VIX 25.64 still above the 15-25 normal band.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Defense/long duration (TLT): gate open at 4.859% but NFP was hot. Signal: first tranche only if Wednesday's US CPI does not accelerate; hot CPI = stay parked (~62% idle cash).
  • Asia semis (SMIC 0981.HK): Friday's condition MET (held far above 41.06). Signal: if SMIC holds HK$44-46 early this week, begin staged entry; size before NVDA earnings 17 Nov, not after.
  • Silver (XAGUSD): hands-off on leverage at 1.91x. Signal: ratio below ~1.7x AND spot above $55 before any add; a Hormuz spike above $55 at ratio above 1.9x is a deleveraging window, not an add window.

trumpWatch.title: Blockbuster NFP locks the December hike
trumpWatch.detail: October payrolls +165k vs +65k expected; unemployment 4.1%; Aug/Sep revised +84k; wages +0.4% m/m. NEC's Hassett: labor demand 'skyrocketing', claims lowest since WWII. 10y settled 4.859% (+2.2bp) even as stocks rebounded.

trumpWatch.title: Iran diplomacy's best weekend yet
trumpWatch.detail: Trump to CNN Sunday: renewed war 'highly unlikely' if Tehran signs 'a very strong agreement'; Vance and senior officials given 'a few days' to land it. Iran's Doha proposal demands sanctions relief, frozen assets, reparations; Araghchi offers Hormuz reopening within two days if conditions met.

trumpWatch.title: ...but the kinetic tape did not stop
trumpWatch.detail: Weekend explosions on Qeshm Island and Bandar Abbas; two tankers reportedly hit Hormuz mines plus a UKMTO projectile strike; US forces disabled the M/V Huda in the Gulf of Oman; a third US carrier strike group arrived. WTI ~$89.8 Friday - oil can gap either way at tonight's open.

trumpWatch.title: Post-blue-wave scorecard: worst week since June
trumpWatch.detail: SPX -4.36% Thursday (chips' worst day since Mar 2020), +0.31% Friday rebound; Nasdaq still in correction. VIX back to 25.64 from 28.18. NVDA earnings 17 Nov is the next AI-complex test under a Democratic Congress.

trumpWatch.title: Week ahead: US CPI is the gate input
trumpWatch.detail: 9-13 Nov: US CPI (first inflation print since the FOMC hold), China inflation, UK GDP, BoJ Summary of Opinions, NZ elections.

trumpWatch.title: Singapore banks week closes mixed
trumpWatch.detail: OCBC Q3 beat: +3% y/y S$2.04bn, NII six-quarter high S$2.31bn (higher SORA net positive), record WM AUM S$358bn, NPL 0.8%, 9M record S$6.24bn. DBS missed Thursday; UOB reported 4 Nov. Local banks are net beneficiaries of higher-for-longer.

opportunities.signal: Deploy a first tranche toward the 15% Defense target only if Wednesday's US CPI does not accelerate; a hot CPI with a December hike ahead = stay parked (~62% of liquid book still idle cash).

opportunities.signal: If SMIC holds the HK$44-46 zone early this week, begin staged entry for the Asia-semis leg of the 15% AI-bottlenecks target; size before NVDA earnings 17 Nov, not after.
